name: single-offer-9x16
summary: Single-offer ad. Logo bar, tall video window, cream panel with a pill, a two-tone headline, one wide CTA, a hairline rule and a URL line.
notes: Measured off a 4:5 reference with a 556px panel. Retargeting keeps the bar and the panel at their measured size and gives the video window whatever height is left, so the panel reads identically across ratios: 1180px of footage at 9:16, 610px at 4:5, 340px at 1:1 (a wide strip — check the crop on the contact sheet). The reference has two side-by-side CTAs at [100,528] and [552,980]; this template carries one wide centred button. The reference also has a date line at y=1044 (reference coords) between headline and CTAs — omitted here, with the gap closed by moving the headline down 16px.
